title: How to Build with the Department of Defense

reader_summary.headline: The DOD is a black box, and I say that meaningfully because we're trying to fix it.
reader_summary.overview: The DOD is a black box, and I say that meaningfully because we're trying to fix it. We want to overwhelm the system with how much better it can be. The US Army should never trade blood for blood in first contact.

key_points.text: The US Army should never trade blood for blood in first contact.
key_points.evidence_quote: The US Army should never trade blood for blood in first contact, it should always be blood for an iron and it should always be their blood.

key_points.text: In 2025, when people think of government, speed or innovation aren't typically words that come to mind, but this was not always the case.

key_points.text: In the early four days, we built the Pentagon in 16 months.

thesis: The podcast discusses the Department of Defense as a 'black box' that is undergoing a cultural and process shift to integrate commercial technology and accelerate innovation. It outlines pathways for startups to engage with the DOD by moving from R&D concepts to minimally viable products through organizations like DIU and AFWORKS.
